Supersectors adding jobs (12 months)

unemployment.title: Unemployment rate: DFW vs Texas vs U.S.
unemployment.headline: DFW's unemployment rate was 4.1% in Sep 2026 (preliminary; not seasonally adjusted), down 0.1 points from a year earlier. Texas: 4.4% (Oct 2026); U.S.: 4.1% (Oct 2026), both seasonally adjusted.

jobs.title: Payroll job growth, 12-month % change
jobs.headline: Over the year to Oct 2026 (preliminary), DFW payroll jobs grew 1.6%, above the U.S. (0.6%) and above Texas (1.4%). Gap vs the U.S.: +1.0 points.

monthly_jobs.title: DFW monthly job change (seasonally adjusted)
monthly_jobs.headline: DFW added 18.9K jobs in Oct 2026 (preliminary; seasonally adjusted); the 3-month average change is +5.5K a month.

wages.title: Wages vs inflation, 12-month % change
wages.headline: DFW average hourly earnings were +3.6% over the year to Oct 2026 (preliminary). In Sep 2026, wages were +3.7% against DFW inflation of 3.0% (U.S.: 3.7%).

real_wages.title: Real wage growth: wage growth minus inflation
real_wages.headline: In Sep 2026, real hourly pay rose measured against DFW prices (+0.7 points) and was roughly flat against U.S. prices (0.0 points). Metro wage data are noisy month to month.

traces.name: Deflated by DFW CPI-U (every other month)

hpi.title: Home prices, % change from a year earlier (FHFA, quarterly)
hpi.headline: In Q2 2026, home prices were +0.5% vs a year earlier in the Dallas-Plano-Irving division and +0.7% in Fort Worth-Arlington-Grapevine (FHFA all-transactions index). The largest gain since 2017 was +27.7% for Dallas in Q2 2022.

mortgage.title: 30-year fixed mortgage rate (U.S.)
mortgage.headline: The 30-year fixed rate averaged 7.33% in Oct 2026, 1.07 points above a year earlier; latest weekly reading 7.28% (Nov 19, 2026).

permits.title: DFW housing units authorized, past 12 months
permits.headline: 60,632 new homes were authorized in DFW in the 12 months to Sep 2026, 12.0% fewer than in the 12 months before.

sahm.title: Sahm-rule-style gauge (heuristic)
sahm.headline: DFW's gauge is 0.32 points (Sep 2026), below the 0.5 threshold used for the national Sahm rule; the U.S. reading is 0.00 points (Oct 2026). A heuristic, not a recession call.

traces.name: DFW (from this project's seasonally adjusted rate)

supersectors.title: DFW jobs by supersector: change over the year to Oct 2026
supersectors.headline: Over the year to Oct 2026 (preliminary), 7 of 10 DFW supersectors added jobs. Largest gain: Professional & business services (+44.6K). Largest decline: Information (−4.1K).

gaps: Oct 2025: no value was published for unemployment rate (DFW, Texas, U.S.); CPI-U (U.S.). BLS footnote: “Data unavailable due to the 2025 lapse in appropriations.” Charts leave a gap, and 12-month changes and 3-month averages that need Oct 2025 are left blank, including the 12-month change for Oct 2026 (U.S. CPI-U).
notes.seasonal_adjustment_check: Check of the seasonal adjustment: the same method applied to the Texas and U.S. rates matches BLS's official seasonally adjusted rates with a mean absolute error of 0.10 and 0.05 percentage points (129 and 129 months).
